indicator_name: Kazakhstan population, UN World Population Prospects 2024: projection variants, sex, broad age groups, demographic indicators, 1950-2100
description: Население Казахстана по оценкам и прогнозу ООН (World Population Prospects 2024): варианты прогноза, пол, возрастные группы, демографические показатели, 1950-2100
unit: thousand persons at 1 July (rates and ages as named)
methodology: TOTAL.<VARIANT> for every WPP variant (MEDIUM, HIGH, LOW, CONSTANT_FERTILITY, ZERO_MIGRATION, …, the 80 % and 95 % prediction intervals); MALE, FEMALE, AGE_0_14, AGE_15_64, AGE_65, POP_1JAN, BIRTHS, DEATHS, TFR, LIFE_EXPECTANCY, NET_MIGRATION, MEDIAN_AGE, GROWTH_RATE, INFANT_MORTALITY for the medium variant. Estimates to 2023, projections 2024-2100. Medium: 2024 20 592.6 thousand (15-64: 12 761.9), 2050 26 544.3, 2100 33 672.2. The UN's estimate for 2024 is about 400 thousand above BNS (POPULATION_BNS) -- different census adjustments.
